paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: The influence of number of blanks to .
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the influence of the number of blanks on the accuracy of the Qwen2.5-VL-72B model, as measured in percentage. The x-axis, labeled “# Blanks,” is linear and ranges from 1 to 6, with integer tick marks at each unit. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, is also linear and ranges from 0 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 20. A single blue line with circular markers represents the Qwen2.5-VL-72B model’s performance. The line starts at approximately 65% accuracy when the number of blanks is 1, then drops sharply to around 25% at 2 blanks, further declines to about 5% at 3 blanks, and remains near 0% for 4, 5, and 6 blanks. The data points are connected by a solid line, showing a steep decline in accuracy as the number of blanks increases.
